formulas.screen_space_error: ε_screen = ρ × r / d  (pixel density × cluster radius / distance)
formulas.lod_threshold: ε_screen > 4 px → switch to lower-detail cluster
formulas.qem_plane_quadric: K = (n, d)ᵀ (n, d)  where plane is n·v + d = 0
formulas.qem_error: Error(v') = v'ᵀ K v', minimize → K v' = [0,0,0,1]ᵀ
formulas.dag_total_memory: Total ≈ 2n triangles for n base triangles (geometric series)

implementation_notes: Use meshoptimizer (OSS) for meshlet generation + cluster grouping
Use METIS for k-way partitioning of triangle graph
QEM simplification: build per-vertex quadrics from face normals
DAG edges: parent cluster has half the triangles of 2 children combined
Streaming: only load clusters visible at current ε_screen threshold
Reference: UE5 Nanite SIGGRAPH 2021 talk, Texturing Mesh Shaders by AMD
